title: Estimating Standard: Roof Code-Upgrade Allowance under the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy
content:
**Estimating Standard: building-code upgrade of a re-settled roof, HomeGuard Homeowners Policy.**

When wind or hail roof surfacing damage on a HomeGuard claim is re-settled from a below-deductible denial, a code-upgrade allowance is added at a percentage of the roof surfacing's replacement-cost value, set by the dwelling's age and the tier's ordinance-or-law percentage.

## Standard

The dwelling's age is counted in whole years from 1 January of the year built on the declarations to the date of loss.

| Dwelling age at the date of loss | Tier's ordinance-or-law percentage | Allowance, percent of roof surfacing replacement-cost value |
|---|---|---|
| At least 50 years | At least 25 | 10 |
| At least 50 years | Below 25 | 5 |
| Younger than 50 years | Any | No allowance |

The allowance is added to the reversal payment on the roof surfacing before the payment is floored at 0.00 and rounded to the cent once. The replacement-cost value it is taken on is the one recorded on the roof surfacing's below-deductible denial entry. The tier's ordinance-or-law percentage is the package figure shown on the HomeGuard schedule of coverages.

## Boundaries

- **Age 50 exactly qualifies.** A dwelling built in 1974 is 50 years old for any loss dated in 2024 (counted from 1 January 1974), so it is in the first two rows. A dwelling built in 1975 is 49 for a loss dated in 2024 and takes no allowance.
- **Ordinance-or-law percentage 25 exactly** is "at least 25" and gives 10 percent; a percentage of 10 gives 5 percent, provided the dwelling is at least 50 years old.
- The percentage alone never produces an allowance: on a dwelling younger than 50 years, no allowance applies whatever the tier's ordinance-or-law percentage.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

Roof surfacing replacement-cost value 16000.00; dwelling built in 1960; loss in 2024 (age 64); tier ordinance-or-law percentage 25. Allowance: 10 percent of 16000.00, which is 1600.00. On a tier whose ordinance-or-law percentage is 10, the same roof takes 5 percent, 800.00.
